news.analysis: Gibbs fell one yard shy of posting a 100-yard game in both rushing and receiving. He continued his dominant season in Germany, bringing his touchdown total up to 13 in nine games. He will be a locked-in top-three fantasy option heading into Week 11 vs. Tampa Bay.
news.contents: Jahmyr Gibbs carried the ball 22 times for 153 yards and two touchdowns while catching seven of his eight targets for 99 yards in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich in Week 10.
news.title: Jahmyr Gibbs scores twice in Munich game

news.contents: Detroit Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs had 22 carries for 153 yards and two touchdowns in a 35-10 win against the New England Patriots in Week 10. He added seven catches on eight targets for 99 yards that helped propel Detroit to victory. That brings Gibbs to a league-leading 177 carries this season for the third-most rushing yards (847) and the second-most rushing touchdowns (9). news.analysis: Cook found the end zone on a 74-yard rush late the in the fourth quarter to salvage what would have been a disappointing fantasy day. Cook has found the end zone in every game this season since Week 2 against Detroit. Cook will look to continue his strong season against Miami in Week 11.
news.contents: James Cook III rushed for 157 yards and a touchdown on 18 carries in a 31-12 win over the Jets. He did not record a reception on his lone target.
news.title: James Cook III hits pay dirt in Week 10 win

news.contents: Buffalo Bills running back James Cook III had 56 yards on 13 carries at halftime and added 101 yards on five attempts after the break in Sunday's 31-12 win over the New York Jets. On Buffalo's first snap after a fourth-quarter fumble recovery, he went off right tackle for a career-long 74-yard touchdown. The score made Cook the third Bills running back to reach 50 scrimmage touchdowns, joining O.J. Simpson and Thurman Thomas. Cook also opened a third-quarter drive with a 21-yard run, and Josh ...
news.title: James Cook III Breaks Off Career-Long Touchdown in 157-Yard Game

news.contents: Cincinnati Bengals wide receiver Ja'Marr Chase caught 11 of his 14 targets for 231 yards during Sunday's Week 10 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers. The former first-round pick has been absolutely spectacular lately, totaling 10+ catches and 30+ PPR points in each of his last three games. This was the fourth 200-yard performance of Chase's career, as well as his second in the last three years. The 26-year-old ranks as a high-end WR1 in fantasy football and has been a huge reason why the Bengals ...
news.title: Ja'Marr Chase Delivers a Remarkable Performance on Sunday Night

news.analysis: This was Washington's second 100-yard game of the season and his highest yardage total overall. He was limited to just two catches against Baltimore last time out, failing to corral some targets that should have been caught. However, he made his opportunities count this time around, going nuclear against the Titans' woeful defense. He's right on the edge of WR1/WR2 territory from here on out.
news.contents: Parker Washington caught seven of nine targets for 152 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
news.title: Parker Washington explodes against Titans

news.contents: Jacksonville Jaguars wide receiver Parker Washington was one of the stars of his team's 40-23 win over the Tennessee Titans in Week 10, recording seven catches for 152 yards and a touchdown on nine targets. Entering Week 10, Washington had been held under 65 receiving yards and five receptions in three straight games. Still, the 24-year-old is in the midst of a breakout season. Across nine games, Washington has hauled in 36 catches for 645 yards and six touchdowns on 64 targets. The Jaguars ...
news.title: Parker Washington Bounces Back with Huge Week 10 Performance

news.analysis: Pitts Sr. has struggled to make a consistent impact on offense to this point, finishing with less than 60 receiving yards in nine of 10 games. The tight end remains a risky pass-catching option in an inconsistent Atlanta offense for head coach Kevin Stefanski entering the team's Week 11 bye.
news.contents: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught four of his five targets for 50 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 Week 10 loss to the Chiefs.
news.title: Kyle Pitts Sr. catches four passes in Week 10 loss

news.contents: Atlanta Falcons tight end Kyle Pitts Sr. has garnered at least five targets in five straight games, but after scoring a touchdown in three straight in Weeks 5 through 7, the University of Florida product has failed to find the end zone in each of the last two contests and has totaled five catches for 29 yards over that span. Week 10 brings an intriguing matchup, though, as the Falcons take on the Chiefs in Atlanta. Although Kansas City is one of the toughest units against wide receivers, the ...
news.title: Kyle Pitts Sr. Draws Favorable Matchup but Remains a TE2 in Week 10

news.analysis: Szmyt continues his solid season for the Browns. The second-year kicker is now 21-of-24 on field-goal tries this season with a long of 56 yards. He's also 15-of-16 on PATs.
news.contents: Andre Szmyt made 2-of-3 FG attempts and all three of his PATs in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
news.title: Andre Szmyt puts nine points on the board in Week 10 win

news.contents: Cleveland Browns kicker Andre Szmyt can be counted on as a reliable option for Week 10 against the Houston Texans. Szmyt is coming off of a nice game in Week 9 against the New Orleans Saints when he made all three of his field goal attempts. He connected on one from the 30-yard range, one from the 40-yard range, and one from 50 yards plus. Szmyt has been reliable all year with a 19-for-21 mark on all field goals with a long of 56 yards. He is also 12-for-13 on extra-point tries. The matchup ...
news.title: Andre Szmyt Can Be Counted On In Week 10

news.contents: Week 10 of the NFL season closes with a Monday night matchup that most certainly looked much better ahead of the season than it does now.The woeful Chargers have been the league's worst team, and enter this game with an 0-8 record. While the Ravens have been a much more competitive squad, they still sport just a 4-5 record thanks in large part to Lamar Jackson's injuries and absence. New Baltimore quarterback Jacoby Brissett is expected to make his first start for the Ravens since being acquired...

news.contents: Pittsburgh Steelers wide receiver DK Metcalf caught two of his six targets for 54 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's Week 10 loss against the Cincinnati Bengals. He also recorded an octopus, which describes when a player converts a two-point conversion immediately after scoring their own touchdown. The touchdown and two-point conversion salvaged an otherwise disappointing performance from Metcalf, who has now caught 35 of his 70 targets (50% catch rate) so far this season. His catch rate ...

news.analysis: Shakir was one of five Bills' pass catchers to record at least three targets in the win over the Jets. His 26 receiving yards are his lowest since Week 3 against the Chargers. Shakir and the Bills will take on Miami in Week 11.
news.contents: Khalil Shakir caught 2-of-3 targets for 26 yards in a 31-12 win over the Jets. He added 29 rushing yards on three carries.
news.title: Khalil Shakir hauls in two passes in Week 10 win

news.contents: Bills wide receiver Khalil Shakir is looking for a boost in production this week as he and the Buffalo passing game take on the New York Jets. Shakir has recorded nine receptions for 122 yards over the past two weeks and is RotoBaller's 37th-ranked wide receiver in Week 10. Shakir is projected to score nine fantasy points against a Jets pass defense that has allowed 1,000 yards after catch this season, the 10th-most in the NFL. Shakir has recorded 290 yards after catch this year, which is the ...
news.title: Khalil Shakir Faces Interesting Matchup

news.analysis: Rice continues to make the most of sizeable involvement in the Kansas City passing attack, recording five or more receptions in four of his last five games. The wideout remains locked in as a reliable pass-catching option entering a Week 11 matchup against the Arizona Cardinals.
news.contents: Rashee Rice hauled in five of his six targets for a team-leading 82 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 Week 10 win over the Falcons.
news.title: Rashee Rice leads pass-catchers in Week 10 win over Falcons

news.contents: Kansas City Chiefs wide receiver Rashee Rice led the team in targets and finished second on the team in receiving yards in last week's 35-12 win over the New York Jets. Since returning from injury, Rice has been the featured target for quarterback Patrick Mahomes and that should continue to be the case despite dealing with a knee issue. Rice was listed on the team's injury report with a knee injury this week but it did not prevent him from logging full practices all week. After a third full ...
news.title: Rashee Rice Should Continue Being Heavily Targeted At Atlanta

news.analysis: Hollins led the Patriots in receiving in the lopsided loss to Detroit. He has eight catches for 84 yards and a touchdown in his two games since returning from a multi-week injury. That being said, the entire Patriots pass-catching corps will take a hit as Drake Maye (ankle) is looking at a multi-week absence after getting knocked out of the game in Week 10.
news.contents: Mack Hollins caught five of his six targets for 48 yards in a 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich in Week 10.
news.title: Mack Hollins leads Patriots in receiving in Week 10

news.contents: New England Patriots wide receiver Mack Hollins has proven to be a very reliable target for Drake Maye when healthy, and as a result, he remains in the WR3/flex conversation for deeper 12+ team leagues. Hollins returned from injured reserve last week and wasted no time getting involved, as he caught three of six targets for 36 yards and a touchdown while maintaining a 68% snap share. The 33-year-old is averaging 5.2 targets per game this season, and he should continue to occupy a large role if...
news.title: Mack Hollins Continues to Have Deep-League Appeal for Week 10

news.analysis: Dell actually kept the big plays coming Sunday, gaining 29 yards on his first catch of the game. He would bring in two more passes on the day, but both ended up going for negative yardage. Dell is averaging more than 21 yards on his eight grabs over the last three weeks. He's a volatile boom-or-bust fantasy option.
news.contents: Tank Dell brought in 3-of-4 targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.title: Tank Dell catches three passes in Week 10 loss

news.contents: Houston Texans wide receiver Tank Dell finished with 5.1 PPR points on three catches for 21 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Cleveland Browns. His lone carry went for no gain in the first quarter, and a third-down pass intended for him fell incomplete on the next snap. Dell's 29-yard catch later in the quarter opened the drive that ended with an 11-yard touchdown pass from C.J. Stroud to Xavier Hutchinson. His other two catches each lost four yards, and he went without a fourth-quarter ...
news.title: Tank Dell Manages 21 Yards in Loss to Cleveland

news.analysis: Wingard may not be available to play on Sunday, as he's currently dealing with a groin issue of some kind that left him sidelined for Thursday and Friday's practices. Arizona's secondary will be weaker than usual if he's ruled out.
news.contents: Andrew Wingard (groin) is considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams.
news.title: Andrew Wingard (groin) considered questionable for Sunday

Njoku has been on injured reserve since Sept. 23 and still needs to be activated for Week 10. He was limited Thursday and Friday, matching his participation in all three practices last week before he was listed as doubtful and sat out against Houston. His last appearance was against the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 2, when he caught one pass for nine yards...

news.analysis: Parsons isn't quite ready to make his return to the lineup and will be sidelined for another game on Sunday. He will likely be ready to go after the team's bye in Week 11, so their defensive front will have to continue to make due without him in the meantime.
